fusions.name: Startle Flare
fusions.desc: Pops a flare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Launched Tines
fusions.desc: A spring rack shoots tines at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Headlamp Glare
fusions.desc: Throws a lamp beam that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Panic Button
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. You also have +6% dodge chance.
